```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
library(yaml); library(glue)

find_data <- function(f) {
  p <- file.path("_data", f); if (file.exists(p)) return(p)
  p2 <- file.path("..", "_data", f); if (file.exists(p2)) return(p2)
  stop(paste("Cannot find", f))
}

proj <- yaml::read_yaml(find_data("projects.yml"))

render_tags <- function(tags) {
  if (is.null(tags)) return("")
  spans <- paste0('<span class="dc-tag">', tags, '</span>', collapse=" ")
  paste0('<div class="dc-tag-row" style="margin-top:1rem;">', spans, '</div>')
}

render_links <- function(links) {
  if (is.null(links)) return("")
  items <- sapply(links, function(l) glue('<a class="dc-btn dc-btn-outline" href="{l$url}" target="_blank" style="font-size:0.5rem;">{l$label} &rarr;</a>'))
  paste0('<div class="dc-btns" style="margin-top:1.25rem;">', paste(items), '</div>')
}

render_project <- function(p, is_past=FALSE) {
  past_style <- if (is_past) "opacity:0.8;" else ""
  active_badge <- if (!is_past) '<span class="dc-badge" style="margin-bottom:0.75rem;display:inline-flex;"><span class="dc-badge-dot"></span>Now &middot; Active</span><br>' else ""
  funder <- if (!is.null(p$funder)) glue('<span style="font-family:var(--f-mono);font-size:0.58rem;color:var(--muted);display:block;margin-bottom:0.2rem;">Funder: {p$funder}</span>') else ""
  partners <- if (!is.null(p$partners)) glue('<span style="font-family:var(--f-mono);font-size:0.58rem;color:var(--muted);display:block;margin-bottom:0.75rem;">Partners: {paste(p$partners,collapse=" · ")}</span>') else ""
  glue('
<div class="dc-card" style="margin-bottom:1px;{past_style}">
  {active_badge}
  <div style="font-family:var(--f-mono);font-size:0.56rem;letter-spacing:0.1em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--forest-2);margin-bottom:0.5rem;">{p$years}</div>
  <h3 style="font-family:var(--f-display);font-weight:700;font-size:1.1rem;letter-spacing:-0.02em;color:var(--ink);margin-bottom:0.6rem;">{p$title}</h3>
  {funder}{partners}
  <p style="font-family:var(--f-display);font-size:0.82rem;line-height:1.8;color:var(--muted);margin-bottom:0;">{p$description}</p>
  {render_tags(p$tags)}
  {render_links(p$links)}
</div>')
}
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis

cat('<div style="padding:3rem 4rem;">')

# Current
cat('<div class="dc-divider"><span class="dc-divider-label">01 — Current Projects</span><div class="dc-divider-line"></div></div>')
for (p in proj$current) cat(render_project(p, is_past=FALSE), "\n")

# Past
cat('<div class="dc-divider" style="margin-top:4rem;"><span class="dc-divider-label">02 — Past Research</span><div class="dc-divider-line"></div></div>')
for (p in proj$past) cat(render_project(p, is_past=TRUE), "\n")

cat('</div>')
```
